book.bencao.gather:
Bencao: Gathering

Break short grass or ferns without shears: 10% chance of herb seeds.

Mint is common; ginseng is rare.

Book + wheat seeds makes this guide.
book.bencao.grow:
Growing Herbs

Plant on lit farmland near water. Bone meal works.

Break mature crops for herbs and seeds.

Young crops only return a seed.
book.bencao.process:
Dry and Grind

Dry herbs in a furnace (10s) or on a campfire (30s).

Dried herb + mortar makes powder.

See the next page for the mortar recipe.

book.bencao.brew:
Mixing

Mint or mugwort powder + water bucket + bowl.

Ginseng needs two powders, a honeycomb, a water bucket and a bowl.

The bucket is returned.
book.bencao.boil:
Brewing

Heat an unbrewed drink in a furnace (20s) or on a campfire (30s).

Hold use to drink, even at full hunger.

Drinking returns a bowl.
